title: Nonlinear determination and phase retrieval under unimodular constraints
summary: We study nonlinear determination problems in Hilbert spaces in which inner products are observed up to prescribed rotations in the complex plane. Given a Hilbert space $H$ and a subset $Θ$ of the unit circle $\mathbb{T}$, we say that a system $\mathbf{G}\subseteq H$ does $Θ$-phase retrieval ($Θ$-PR) if for all $f,h\in H$ the condition that for every $g\in\mathbf{G}$ there exists $θ_g\inΘ$ with $\langle f,g\rangle=θ_g\langle h,g\rangle$ forces $f=θh$ for some $θ\inΘ$.
